title: Proxy Solution 1
description: Ops pages VDI. Service Desk has an influx of tickets: users cannot access or authenticate to Microsoft 365 apps, including OneDrive. It looks sporadic — not every user. Reports are from different locations, on AVD Personal and Multi-Session.
scope: Out-of-hours: sporadic M365 / OneDrive access from AVD Personal and Multi-Session.
illustrativeDisclaimer: This scenario, its mock incident, runbook titles, product names, escalation routes, and organisational procedures are illustrative. Validate them against approved operational sources before use. They are not bank-specific policy.
assessorGuidance: Reward refusing an AVD-only story. Personal and Multi-Session, random locations. Check M365 status portals, get TRM in, Ops to call the OneDrive team, and Microsoft via CritSit for a SevA response within 15 minutes. Smoking gun: this is larger than AVD — OneDrive / M365 auth. Recovery is vendor support, logs, OneDrive team reporting, and multiple users confirming. Safety-critical: do not assume it is only AVD and start changing the VDI platform.
acceptableAlternativeApproaches: M365 status first, then TRM and OneDrive team, with CritSit in parallel if the portal or pattern says tenant-side.
Confirm Personal and Multi-Session and mixed locations first, then CritSit plus OneDrive callout.
PAA/path glance so proxy is not ignored, then still prove it is larger than AVD.

questions.helpText: Personal and Multi-Session are both reporting. Think about how wide this is before you change anything on AVD.
questions.assessorGuidance: Score the whole write-up. Reward: M365 status portals; TRM; Ops to bring the OneDrive team; Microsoft CritSit for SevA within 15 minutes; concluding it is larger than AVD (OneDrive / M365 auth); PAA noted but not used as the whole story; recovery with vendor, logs, OneDrive reporting, and more than one user. Do not score as demonstrated: AVD-only rebuild, drain, or PAA uninstall as the first move; skipping Microsoft because 'we can fix AVD ourselves'.

scoringCriteria.label: Does not assume AVD-only when Personal, Multi-Session, and mixed locations are all reporting
Uses M365 status portals and gets Ops to engage the OneDrive team
Engages Microsoft via CritSit for a SevA response within 15 minutes
Brings TRM in and keeps the incident as a cross-team issue, not a VDI-only ticket
Notes PAA is on the platform without making proxy the whole story
Confirms recovery with vendor support, OneDrive reporting, and multiple users
Does not change the AVD platform on an unproven AVD-only assumption
